records.primary_location: Figure 5 and text in Catalytic performance toward CO2 Hydrogenation to methanol
records.notes: Text gives exact CO2 conversion and STYMeOH for Cu/Al2O3-HT at 310 °C and 3 MPa. Figure 5d also reports TOFMeOH = 46.9 h−1 in text, but no field is provided here. CO and CH4 selectivities are not reported in the main text/figure.

extraction_notes: Main article states that preparation, characterization, and catalytic testing details are in the supporting information, which was not included in the supplied text; therefore feed composition/H2:CO2 ratio, catalyst mass, and total flow are unavailable. Figure 5 gives temperature-series catalytic performance for four catalysts at P = 3 MPa and GHSV = 12,000 mL/(g·h). Values from Figure 5 were read approximately from the plotted axes (qualifier '~') except the Cu/Al2O3-HT 310 °C CO2 conversion (23.5%) and STYMeOH (94.4 gMeOH h−1 kgcat−1), which are printed in the text. Literature-comparison Table S5 and supporting-information tables were not supplied and were not extracted.
